purpose: Design-only, read-only delta plan for future PvP caps, boss resistances, control duration policy, heal/shield/revive anti-loop rules, Marchio Boreale boundaries, Domain stacking policy, and Divine Weapon synergy constraints. No patch is applied. No runtime hook. Intended as input to a future v5 baseline if any of these recommendations get drafted into the catalogs.
current_state_assertions: baseline v4 is current default anchor (RM1.32-B)
greek_borea catalog-only, hidden in /api/heroes, Marchio Boreale Borea-only

principles: PvP-specific caps must NEVER mutate the foundation_draft numbers; they must be enforced at runtime adapter (RM1.33-A) via a PvP mode flag.
All caps are design-only proposals; no runtime hook is taken in RM1.32-C.

damage_cap.single_target_ultimate_or_skill_2: cap effective damage_multiplier_pct at 600 in PvP (still draft); one-shot prevention rule: target must survive with ≥10% max_hp from any single non-true-damage hit
damage_cap.aoe_ultimate_per_target: cap at 380 per target in PvP
damage_cap.true_damage: not introduced at foundation pass; reserved for future review

shield_cap.principle: PvP shield stacking cap at 2 concurrent shields per ally; total shield_multiplier_pct effective cap at 460 in PvP
shield_cap.decay_rule: design-only: oldest shield decays first when cap is exceeded

heal_cap.principle: PvP healing effectiveness scaled to ~75% of PvE (−25%); raid bosses cap heal effectiveness at ~50% to prevent attrition stalemates
heal_cap.healing_block_interaction: healing_block status must reduce heal multiplier to 0 while active, both PvE and PvP

hard_control_duration_cap.freeze_stun_silence: cap at 1–2 turns in PvP regardless of foundation duration; 3-turn duration permitted in PvE only

status_chance_cap.principle: PvP status_chance_pct effective cap at 85% even when foundation_draft is ≥90%; PvE keeps full chance

candidates_flagged_by_audit: 6★ single-target ultimates with damage_multiplier_pct ≥ 600 → PvP cap candidates
6★ AoE ultimates with damage_multiplier_pct ≥ 380 per target → PvP AoE cap candidates
hard control duration ≥ 3 → PvP cap candidates

principles: Boss resistance is design-only; future runtime layer (post-RM1.33-A) will translate these into numeric resist tables.
Hard control on bosses MUST have diminishing-returns rules to avoid infinite lock loops.

hard_control_resistance.freeze_stun_silence_taunt: 1st application: full duration; 2nd within N turns: 50% duration; 3rd within N turns: immune (immunity window 2 turns)
hard_control_resistance.boss_unique_immunities: design-only: each boss family declares its hard-control immunity profile in a future RM1.34 boss table

mark_and_marchio_rules.mark: stack cap 5 in PvE, 3 in PvP (matches Marchio Boreale stack policy)
mark_and_marchio_rules.marchio_boreale: Borea-only; bosses cap effective stacks at max_stacks_pve − 1 (i.e. 4)

dot_scaling_rules.burn_poison_bleed_frostbite_shock: boss DoT multiplier capped at 0.5× of standard damage tick; cannot critically tick on boss
dot_scaling_rules.stacking: max 3 distinct DoT instances per boss target (PvE); 2 (PvP)

healing_reduction_block_rules.healing_block: reduces heal to 0 while active; max duration 2 turns even from any source
healing_reduction_block_rules.healing_reduction: applied multiplicatively; cap at −60% effective heal per stack and never below 20% baseline heal

principles: No domain_effect tags are currently present in 5★/6★ catalogs (audit confirms 0 domain-like tags).
Reserve the policy for future tasks that introduce domain skills.
domain_recommendations.stacking_policy: one_domain_active_per_battle_side (max 1 ally + 1 enemy domain active simultaneously)
domain_recommendations.override_policy: strongest_wins; ties broken by application order (FIFO); cleansable like a status
domain_recommendations.duration_policy: max 3 turns; cannot be refreshed in the same turn

marchio_boreale_recommendations.scope: per-target personal status; cannot transfer to other heroes; cannot grant team-wide damage amp
marchio_boreale_recommendations.cleanse_rules: standard cleanse removes all stacks at once; cannot be partially cleansed
marchio_boreale_recommendations.immunity_rules: status immunity prevents new stacks; existing stacks decay normally
marchio_boreale_recommendations.decay_rule: 1 stack decays at end of marked unit turn unless re-applied; resets fully on cleanse
marchio_boreale_recommendations.boss_resistance: bosses cap effective stacks at max_stacks_pve - 1 = 4; freeze chance bonus contribution from Marchio is halved on bosses

future_runtime_caps.no_multiplicative_with_other_buffs: DW synergy is additive only at first runtime pass
future_runtime_caps.no_team_wide_amp: DW synergy is per-owner-hero only; never benefits teammates
future_runtime_caps.no_pvp_amplification: DW synergy yields ≤ +5% in PvP only

divine_weapon_synergy_recommendations.until_runtime_adapter: no live hooks; gated by SKILL_KIT_RUNTIME_ENABLED feature flag (RM1.33-A)

heal_shield_revive_recommendations.revive_anti_loop_rule: max 1 revive per ally per battle (PvE) and per match (PvP)
heal_shield_revive_recommendations.revive_cooldown_intern: per-skill internal_cooldown ≥ 5 turns mandatory at runtime layer
heal_shield_revive_recommendations.death_protection_window: 1 turn max; cannot stack with revive_pending in the same turn
heal_shield_revive_recommendations.shield_overstack_rule: max 2 concurrent shields per ally; total shield_multiplier_pct effective cap 460 in PvP

RM1.32-C2_optional.description: If user requests, draft minimal numeric tweaks (foundation_draft only) addressing the highest WARNs: PvP status chance ≥90 → trim to ≤85 in foundation_draft (would produce baseline v5).

RM1.33-A_runtime_adapter_prerequisites.description: Implement Runtime Adapter Skeleton with feature flag SKILL_KIT_RUNTIME_ENABLED=false. Adapter must read foundation_draft values, apply PvP/Boss caps from this plan, and never mutate the catalogs.
must_provide: PvP cap layer (damage / shield / heal / status chance / control duration)
Boss resistance layer (hard control diminishing returns, DoT cap, heal reduction)
Marchio Boreale boss cap (max_stacks_pve - 1) at runtime
Revive anti-loop counter per battle / match
Domain stacking policy enforcement (when domain skills are introduced)
DW synergy numeric modifier cap (≤ +10% global / ≤ +5% PvP)

RM1.34_boss_table_design.description: Author boss family resistance/immunity table referencing this plan as the design contract.

out_of_scope: gacha / roster / Character Bible / assets changes
recommended_next_baseline: hero_skill_kit_catalog_baseline_rm132c2_v5 (only if RM1.32-C2 optional patch is approved); otherwise no new baseline needed for this plan
